gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-mada: Mada keeps its curves open and its midzone towering, friendly and modern. Blockletter, a display face with a pipe-cleaner feel in every letterform, gives the sans-serif body a precise, pencil-sketched lead-in.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-martel-sans: Sketched, precise, modern: Blockletter looks drawn with a single nib, its tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. And Martel Sans, with generous curve openings and a high mean line, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-michroma: Blockletter's letters read like outlines drawn in one width, with a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. But Michroma gives each letter a wide berth on both sides, leaving daylight in its curves.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-kufi-arab: Noto Kufi Arabic, a sans with a welcoming gap in the c, keeps capitals only slightly above lowercase. Blockletter leads with round letters whose walls are as stout as straight ones.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-adla: Precise and modern, Blockletter has a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly, with every diagonal as stout as every upright. Blockletter commands attention while Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined gives curves generous breathing room.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-anat: No thin strokes to vanish in glare: Blockletter has a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs then reads with outward-pointing terminals and a tall x-height, so paragraphs feel lifted and open.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-arab: Noto Sans Arabic opens its small letters wide, with a pronounced x-height. Blockletter skims along on stroke weight that never changes, and paragraphs in this body settle into a smooth, easy rhythm.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-arme: Blockletter draws one stroke thickness everywhere, with a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly. Noto Sans Armenian, with tall, full c, s and z and wide round openings, makes paragraphs feel inviting.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-aves: Noto Sans Avestan is a modern sans whose curve tips never touch, with a pronounced x-height. What stands out most is Blockletter's ruler-drawn, constant-width line against that open body.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-noto-sans-bali: Noto Sans Balinese reads with breathing space inside every curved glyph, though its ascenders stay short against the body height. Blockletter's curves hold full thickness at the shoulders, so text beneath feels grounded.
